en.title: Uniform Launch
en.intro: Each eligible identity bids once. Winning bids settle at one price.
en.unbound: Preview build. Wallet actions become available when this app is bound to a reviewed testnet factory.
en.walletRequired: Use the wallet on the Flap host and select BSC Testnet to preview a transaction.
en.name: Token name · up to 32 bytes
en.durationHint: 200–20,000 blocks, about 1m 30s–2h 30m at 0.45s per block. Testnet block times vary. Bidding closes 20 blocks before settlement.
en.admissionHint: On testnet, leave empty to admit all eligible identities. Otherwise enter up to 128 unique addresses, separated by spaces or commas.
en.bidRisk: Your full budget is escrowed until settlement. Range 0.01–100 tBNB. Set a maximum price you are willing to pay.
en.signHint: Review the address and amount. Flap will ask your wallet to confirm the transaction.
en.hostError: Flap could not complete this step
en.reverted: The transaction reverted. Review the auction state before trying again.
en.badTarget: This address is not a registered auction of the selected factory.
en.invalidWallets: Enter up to 128 distinct, valid, nonzero wallet addresses.
en.invalidName: Check the token name and symbol byte limits.
en.invalidMeta: Enter the metadata IPFS CID, without a URL or path.
en.invalidDuration: Enter a whole number from 200 to 20,000 blocks.
en.invalidFloor: Enter a positive reserve price with up to 18 decimals and within the contract limit.
en.invalidLimit: Enter a valid limit at or above the reserve and within the contract price cap.
en.invalidBudget: Bid budget must be between 0.01 and 100 tBNB.
en.invalidIdentity: Choose a supported identity source and enter the identity number as a whole number.
en.badSources: The selected factory returned invalid identity adapters.
en.mineFailed: Could not find a launch salt in this attempt. Preview again to try a new seed.

zh.network: BNB 智能链 · 测试网 97
zh.title: 同价发射
zh.intro: 每个合资格身份可出价一次。所有成交者支付同一清算价。
zh.unbound: 当前为预览版。绑定经核验的测试网工厂后开放钱包操作。
zh.walletRequired: 请在 Flap 宿主钱包中选择 BSC 测试网后预览交易。
zh.switch: 切换至 BSC 测试网
zh.name: 代币名称 · 最多 32 字节
zh.symbol: 代币符号 · 最多 8 字节
zh.durationHint: 可选 200–20,000 个区块。按每区块 0.45 秒估计，约 1 分 30 秒至 2 小时 30 分，测试网实际速度会变化。结算前 20 个区块截止出价。
zh.admissionHint: 测试网留空即允许所有合资格身份。也可用空格或逗号分隔，填入最多 128 个不重复的钱包地址。
zh.binance: 币安 Agent ID · 测试网替身
zh.bidRisk: 预算将全额锁定至结算，可填 0.01–100 tBNB。请填写你愿意支付的最高单价。
zh.signHint: 核对地址和金额。Flap 将请求钱包确认这笔交易。
zh.reverted: 交易已回退，请核对最新拍卖状态。
zh.badTarget: 此地址不属于当前工厂登记的拍卖。
zh.invalidWallets: 请填写最多 128 个不同的有效非零钱包地址。
zh.invalidName: 请核对代币名称与符号的字节限制。
zh.invalidMeta: 请填写元数据的 IPFS CID，无需网址或路径。
zh.invalidDuration: 请输入 200 至 20,000 之间的整数区块数。
zh.invalidFloor: 请输入正数保留价，最多 18 位小数，且在合约上限内。
zh.invalidLimit: 请输入不低于保留价且不超过合约上限的有效最高价。
zh.invalidBudget: 出价预算须为 0.01 至 100 tBNB。
zh.invalidIdentity: 请选择支持的身份来源并填写整数身份编号。
zh.badSources: 当前工厂返回了无效的身份适配器。
zh.mineFailed: 本次未找到发射盐值，请再次预览以重新计算。
zh.draft: 本地草稿 · 未请求钱包
